tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background in both the storefront and the back office. The default ground for everything.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, popovers, inputs, product cards — anything sitting on top of surface. Separate it with a line border, not a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows, filter bars, product-image placeholders, disabled and read-only fields, hover fill of secondary and ghost buttons. A step darker than surface in light, a step lighter in dark. ink and ink-muted both read on it in both themes.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs, drawers and the mobile cart sheet. Darker in the dark theme so the panel still stands apart.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines: card borders, dividers, table row rules. Decorative only — not for control borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, checkboxes and quantity steppers at rest (3.8:1 on surface-raised, 3.4:1 on surface-sunken, 3.2:1 on brand-tint); disabled text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, prices and icons on surface or surface-raised (16:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, SKUs, timestamps, struck-through original prices, placeholder and helper text (5.9:1).

tokens.name: on-solid
tokens.usage: Text and icons on solid fills: brand, brand-hover, brand-active, danger, danger-hover, danger-active, sale. White in light; near-black in dark, where those fills are light. 4.5:1 or more on every fill in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary buttons (Add to cart, Checkout, Save), links, focus rings, selected states. White text on it passes 7.5:1. At most one brand button per view.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of brand buttons. on-solid on it 9.9:1.

tokens.name: brand-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of brand buttons (while the pointer is down). on-solid on it 12.2:1.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet emphasis: selected table rows, active nav item, applied filter chips. Text on it is ink or brand (6.4:1).

tokens.name: brand-tint-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on selected (toggled-on) buttons and selected chips. brand text on it 5.7:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Text and icon of positive states: Paid, Fulfilled, Delivered, In stock. Always on success-tint, always with a label — it sits close to brand in hue.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and banners (success text on it 5.7:1).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Text and icon of states needing attention: Pending, Unfulfilled, Low stock, Partially refunded.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and banners (warning text on it 5.6:1).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Text and icon of in-progress or neutral-system states: Processing, Shipped, In transit, Pre-order.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Background of info badges and banners (info text on it 6.1:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions and failed states: Payment failed, Cancelled, Out of stock. Never decoration. White text on it passes 5.6:1.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of danger buttons. on-solid on it 7.8:1.

tokens.name: danger-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of danger buttons. on-solid on it 9.8:1.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of danger badges, inline field errors and error banners (danger text on it 5.0:1).

tokens.name: sale
tokens.usage: Storefront only: reduced prices and the Sale / −20% badge (6.6:1 on white; white on it 6.6:1). Never for errors, never in the back office.

tokens.name: rating
tokens.usage: Filled review stars and rating icons (3:1+ as an icon). Not for text — print the rating number in ink.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, badge padding, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls; between label and input; table cell vertical padding in compact.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding: vertical in comfortable, horizontal in compact; gap between form fields in compact; gaps in back-office toolbars and filter bars.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding in comfortable; card and panel padding in compact; gap between form fields in comfortable; product-grid gap on mobile; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding in comfortable; product-grid gap on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections in the back office; desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between storefront sections (hero, collections, featured products).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, tags, table thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus, product images.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, cart drawer, sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status badges, filter chips, cart-count bubble, color swatches.

size.note: Fixed sizes. Components read the density variables in styles/density.css (--ctl-h, --ctl-pad …), which map to these; use a size token directly only where a size must not change with density, like storefront Add to cart.

tokens.name: control-slim
tokens.usage: Slim control height: actions inside table cells, filter bars, beside headings, dense side panels. Back office, desktop only — grows to the density size below 640px. Pairs with control-pad-slim, control-text-sm, icon-sm.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact control height: back-office toolbars, table actions, inline selects. Pairs with control-pad-sm, control-text-sm, icon-sm.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Comfortable control height: forms in both surfaces, storefront filters. Pairs with control-pad-md, control-text-md, icon-md.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Storefront primary actions (Add to cart, Checkout) and every mobile touch target, in any density. Pairs with control-pad-lg, control-text-lg, icon-md.

tokens.name: control-pad-slim
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of slim buttons.

tokens.name: control-pad-sm
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of compact buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: control-pad-md
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of comfortable buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: control-pad-lg
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of large storefront buttons.

tokens.name: control-text-sm
tokens.usage: Text inside compact controls, weight 500 for buttons, 400 for input values.

tokens.name: control-text-md
tokens.usage: Text inside comfortable controls (matches body).

tokens.name: control-text-lg
tokens.usage: Text inside large storefront buttons, weight 600. 16px also stops iOS zooming into inputs.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in compact controls, table cells and badges.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size: comfortable and large controls, navigation.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Storefront header icons (cart, account, search) and empty states.

tokens.name: row-dense
tokens.usage: Compact table row height (orders, products, customers).

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: Comfortable table row height, and any row carrying a product thumbnail in either density.
